# Local and remote disks are disjoint. ID 1's disk settles first.
interest radius 1
flight on
teleport 8.5 221.5 8.5
give Glass 3
wait 1
player create
interest radius 2
flight on
teleport 520.5 225 8.5
give Dirt 4
wait 1
expect voxel 8 220 8 air
expect voxel 520 250 8 air

# The ninth remote chunk is registered and awaits generation. Its edge
# edit is accepted and must be captured by save while it is still deferred.
expect voxel 528 250 16 unknown
place 528 250 16 Glass
expect result Ok
expect revision 2
expect pending on
drop 2
expect item 1 Dirt 2
save
expect result Ok
expect pending on
wait 1
expect pending off
expect voxel 528 250 16 Glass

# Disconnect drops remote residency, while the shared edit and item survive.
player remove 2
wait 2
expect voxel 528 250 16 unknown
expect voxel 8 220 8 air
expect inventory 0 Glass 3
expect item 1 Dirt 2

player create
interest radius 2
flight on
teleport 520.5 225 8.5
wait 2
expect voxel 528 250 16 Glass
expect inventory 0 empty 0
expect item 1 Dirt 2
